name: Creation of Adam
description: The epoch of this chronology. Year 0 AM by definition, not by calculation.

name: The Flood
description: Dated from Noah's age at the flood, so its year is derived rather than stated.

name: The Tower of Babel
description: Scripture gives no age or year for this event, so its date is unknown under this chronology.

name: Abraham departs Haran
description: Abraham was 75. The same figure the default chronology uses to derive his birth year.

name: Jacob enters Egypt
description: Jacob was 130 when he stood before Pharaoh.
